html:
A Swedish activist, born in Stockholm in 2003, who started a worldwide youth movement against climate change.

In August 2018, aged 15, she sat alone outside the Swedish parliament with a sign reading "School strike for climate". Her protest spread through social media. By 2019 millions of students in many countries were walking out of school on Fridays, under the name Fridays for Future.

She spoke to the United Nations and to world leaders, telling them they were failing young people, and crossed the Atlantic by sailboat to avoid flying. Her blunt style made her both admired and attacked. She has said her autism helps her see the issue in black and white. Her demand was simple: that governments do what they promised in the Paris Agreement and follow the science. Later she also took up other causes, including Palestine.
sum: A Swedish activist, born in Stockholm in 2003, who started a worldwide youth movement against climate change.
